tools.description:
Read public historical markets/candles/trades, batch books/midpoints/spreads,

Call this to check Kalshi exchange operational status (trading active flag)

tools.name: foresea_price_history
tools.description:
Call this to retrieve historical price series or OHLC candlesticks for a

tools.name: foresea_live_data
tools.description:
Call this to fetch real-time sports game statistics, play-by-play data, and

tools.name: foresea_polymarket_meta
tools.description:
Call this to fetch Polymarket metadata: event series listings, community

tools.name: foresea_recent_trades
tools.description: Call this to fetch recent public executed trades / trade tape (prices, sizes, timestamps) on Kalshi or Polymarket.

tools.name: foresea_market_leaderboard

tools.description: Calculate optimal mathematical Fractional Kelly capital allocations and position sizes across live Grade A/B prediction market opportunities.

tools.name: foresea_feed_latest
tools.description: Fetch the real-time unified Foresea Alpha & Agent Feed, combining live prediction market edge signals, autonomous agent trades & theses, and leaderboard standings.

        calibrated with station micro

tools.name: foresea_batch_forecast
tools.description:
Submit up to 25 forecasting questions concurrently and receive structured predictions
        with confidence probabilities, bull/bear factor decomposition, key catalysts, and evidence
        citations for each question.

tools.name: foresea_crypto_edge
tools.description:
Scan real-time Kalshi cryptocurrency prediction markets (KXBTCD threshold contracts)
        scored against Black-Scholes zero-drift diffusion models and spot volatility. Returns tradeable

tools.name: foresea_webhook_subscribe
tools.description:
Subscribe an external agent HTTP callback webhook to receive real-time dispatches
        for new forecasts and market edge opportunities. The response contains an HMAC secret
        (X-Foresea-Signature) for validating incoming payloads.

tools.name: foresea_trade_account_status
tools.description:
Check real prediction-market trading readiness, max order notional limits,
        and venue configuration statuses for Kalshi and Polymarket.

tools.name: foresea_preview_order
tools.description:
Validate, normalize, and simulate guardrail checks for a real Kalshi or
        Polymarket order without submitting it to the exchange.

tools.name: foresea_place_order
tools.description:
Submit a guarded real order to Kalshi or Polymarket. Live execution requires
        confirmation='PLACE REAL ORDER' and execute=True, and is protected by server

tools.name: foresea_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an active open order on Kalshi or Polymarket using its venue order ID.

        90% ranges, the m

tools.name: foresea_commodity_pairs
tools.description:
Call this when the user asks about relative value between commodities: gold/silver,

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "foresea_webhook_subscribe" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Subscribe an external agent HTTP callback webhook to receive real-time dispatches for new forecasts and market edge opportunities. The response contains an HMAC…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: foresea_forecast, foresea_check_run, foresea_live_data, foresea_polymarket_meta, foresea_feed_latest · Private data: foresea_track_record, foresea_orderbook, foresea_price_history, foresea_webhook_subscribe, foresea_index_forecasts, foresea_commodity_pairs · Public sink: foresea_batch_forecast, foresea_webhook_subscribe, foresea_place_order · Destructive: foresea_check_run, foresea_place_order, foresea_commodity_pairs, foresea_fund_board.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: foresea_forecast, foresea_check_run, foresea_live_data, foresea_polymarket_meta, foresea_feed_latest · Private data: foresea_track_record, foresea_orderbook, foresea_price_history, foresea_webhook_subscribe, foresea_index_forecasts, foresea_commodity_pairs · Public sink: foresea_batch_forecast, foresea_webhook_subscribe, foresea_place_order · Destructive: foresea_check_run, foresea_place_order, foresea_commodity_pairs, foresea_fund_board

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
